posts.caption:
Every dot is a day someone bought Brazil's Bovespa, 5,011 of them from 1993 to 2013. Red means that buyer is losing money.

One day later: 46% are red.
Ten years: still 5 red.

At 12 years 1 month, not one dot is losing.

The last red dot bought in October 2007 and was red for over twelve years.

Every single person who waited made money.

Split-adjusted price, dividends excluded. Not financial advice.
